question: 1. Initial diameter measurement validity
required_evidence: documented measurement procedure, instrument, scale, uncertainty
available_evidence: dispenser spec (+/-0.25 mm, +/-5%) and imaging spec (30 um, 30 fps); no per-run calibration
scientific_consequence: diameter comparisons are usable descriptively; absolute mm-level modelling inputs carry unquantified bias
recommended_next_action: obtain analyzed-data diameter series and scale factors

question: 2. Extinction diameter measurement validity
required_evidence: documented definition of the reduced value and its uncertainty
available_evidence: image-derived per EIRD 5.2.1; table reduction undocumented; 8 zero-mm placeholders flagged
scientific_consequence: 'visible flame extinction diameter' is usable as labelled; it is not chemical extinction
recommended_next_action: confirm reduction procedure and zero-value handling

question: 3. Burning-rate unit validity
required_evidence: documented unit and measurement equation for the table column
available_evidence: none found in any inspected document; EIRD discusses mm2/s d2-law constants in a different (requirements) context
remaining_blocker: PSI data dictionary or originator definition
scientific_consequence: no physically interpreted burning-rate quantity may be computed; all rate conclusions are provisional
recommended_next_action: obtain the column definition before any modelling

question: 4. Burn-duration measurement validity
required_evidence: documented start/stop events and timing accuracy
available_evidence: header verifies seconds; two approximate (~) values preserved; GMT sync spec +/-0.03 s exists
remaining_blocker: start/stop event definitions per record type
scientific_consequence: durations usable; sub-second precision cannot be assumed

question: 5. Pressure measurement validity
available_evidence: mmHg header verified; spec tolerances +/-0.01 atm (EIRD), +/-0.05 atm (ERD); one 0 mmHg anomaly
scientific_consequence: pressure usable as reported with one flagged anomaly

question: 6. Composition measurement validity
required_evidence: verification of reported mole fractions against charge records
available_evidence: spec tolerance +/-0.005 O2; 29 records reported sums != 1.000 (never renormalised)
scientific_consequence: mixture-family comparisons usable; sums must not be forced to unity

question: 7. Outcome-label interpretation
available_evidence: Test Plan LOI procedure documents Extinction/Completion context; 'Disruption' undefined in all inspected documents
scientific_consequence: three-category outcome analyses carry an undefined category; labels are never equated with chemical extinction
recommended_next_action: obtain label definitions from the investigation team

question: 8. Fuel-comparison validity
required_evidence: overlapping conditions, independence, adequate cell sizes
available_evidence: 31/52 shared families (115 MeOH/106 Hep); 14/15 shared O2 levels; adaptive series design; 193F001 collision disclosed. Underlying counts/statistics VERIFIED (EV-026, EV-027)
scientific_consequence: fuel contrasts are descriptive associations, not causal effects; initial-diameter contrast is duplicate-sensitive (p 0.0623->0.0449)

question: 9. CO2/He comparison validity
required_evidence: matched O2, matched N2 balance, shared pressure bands, adequate n
available_evidence: 10 matched-O2 cells; 5 with identical N2 balances; 7 with both sides n>=3; 4 cells (O2=0.16, 0.17, 0.18, 0.24) satisfy both
remaining_blocker: per-cell adequacy enforcement (done in Phase 2); N2 matching
scientific_consequence: only the 4 fully-defensible cells support diluent contrasts; no pooled causal estimate
recommended_next_action: restrict contrasts to the 4 cells; report per-cell

question: 10. Pressure-effect identifiability
required_evidence: pressure variation within a fixed mixture family
available_evidence: all 9 records >800 mmHg in one CO2 family; no within-family cross-band variation for that family
remaining_blocker: high-pressure runs in other mixture families
scientific_consequence: no independently identified pressure effect can be claimed

question: 11. Experimental independence
required_evidence: evidence that records are independent experimental observations
available_evidence: adaptive sequential LOI design (documented); up to 9 records/date; 81 series prefixes; identifier collision
scientific_consequence: all Phase 2 p-values are conditional on an independence assumption that available evidence does not support
recommended_next_action: series-stratified or permutation-based inference; metadata request

question: 12. Telemetry synchronization
required_evidence: clock-offset map across the six observed clock domains
available_evidence: headers identify six clocks; PIP-vs-radiometer offset measured across one file spans 2.1-2.5 s (~2.3 s in the first rows) observed; GMT +/-0.03 s requirement documented
scientific_consequence: no merged time-resolved product is defensible yet
recommended_next_action: build and validate the clock map on one pilot run

question: 13. Image archive usability
required_evidence: extraction, format validation, run linkage, timestamps
available_evidence: 23 archives (TIFF/BMP, 800-1290 frames) with embedded manifests; 20CAL13A absent; known missing frames documented
scientific_consequence: image-derived measurements do not exist yet and must not be claimed
recommended_next_action: pilot-extract one run; validate against manifests

question: 14. d2-law readiness
required_evidence: unit-resolved burning rate + diameter time series + conditions
available_evidence: burning-rate unit unverified; no diameter time series in audited data (only in unextracted archives)
scientific_consequence: no d2-law constant, evaporation constant or regression rate may be computed
recommended_next_action: resolve unit and extract pilot images first

question: 15. Chemical-extinction identifiability
required_evidence: radical/emission or gas-phase composition measurements at flame-out
available_evidence: none in audited data; OH* imaging exists only as unextracted camera archives for 8 runs
remaining_blocker: extraction of OH* series + species measurements
scientific_consequence: visible flame extinction must not be equated with chemical extinction
recommended_next_action: validate OH*/LLLUV frames against the visible-flame label
